comments.message: The 'set' operation resets the expiration time (EX) on every request. This creates a 'sliding window' effect where a user can keep the key alive indefinitely by sending requests within the window, effectively preventing the rate limit from ever resetting.
comments.suggestion: Use 'INCR' and 'EXPIRE' (only on the first increment) or a fixed-window approach to ensure the rate limit resets correctly.
